author: Rahul kp
title: Consignment
simple_words: Consignment: you send goods to an agent to sell. Joint venture: two or more people team up for one venture and share profit.

definitions.meaning: Consignor sends goods to the consignee to sell on his behalf. Ownership stays with the consignor until the goods are sold.
Two or more persons (co-venturers) carry out a particular business venture together and share profit or loss in an agreed ratio.
definitions.note: Not a firm, one venture only

key_points: In consignment, the ==consignee== is only an agent and earns commission.
In a joint venture, co-venturers share ==profit or loss== in the agreed ratio.
!!Unsold goods with the consignee are consignor's stock!! and are valued in his books.
A joint venture usually ends when the venture is complete.

insight.punchline: Agent earns fee, partners share result!
insight.text: The consignee gets commission whatever the result; co-venturers bear the profit or loss together.

memory_trick.mnemonic: C for Commission, J for Join
memory_trick.explanation: Consignment pays the agent a Commission. Joint Venture means people Join hands and share the result.

steps: Spot the parties in the question
Sharing profit in a ratio? Joint venture
exam_tip: Look for the words 'commission' or 'profit sharing ratio' in the question. They tell you which one applies.

doubt.question: Does the consignee own the goods he holds?
doubt.answer: No. He is only an agent and holds the goods. The consignor stays the owner until the goods are sold to a customer.

mistakes.wrong: Treating consignment dispatch as a sale by the consignor
mistakes.right: Dispatch to the consignee is not a sale. Revenue arises only when the consignee sells to a customer.

mistakes.wrong: Calling a joint venture a partnership firm
mistakes.right: A joint venture is for a particular venture. It is not a firm and usually ends when the venture is complete.

mistakes.wrong: Giving the consignee a share of profit as a co-venturer
mistakes.right: The consignee earns commission as an agent. He does not share the profit or loss.
